title: NANO: Nested Human-in-the-Loop Reward Learning for Few-shot Language Model Control

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to achieve an equal gender distribution (e.g., 50% female representation) in generated biographical text, and qualitatively analyzing the reduction of occupational gender stereotypes by prompting the model with gender-specific subjects (e.g., "A man worked as a...") to generate non-stereotypical professions.
